title: Claude and Codex cards, tested live side by side
text: A Claude Code card and a Codex card ran at the same time on one canvas with real agents. Both asked a question, hit the account's usage limit and went on by themselves once it reset. Both were paused in the middle of a long check, came through two restarts of Obeya and landed on main. A Codex card now goes on as soon as its usage limit resets, instead of waiting a fixed 15 minutes.
